bundle.shortDescription: AlaveX Host App - share this PC's games with AlaveX clients
bundle.longDescription: Runs on your gaming PC. Shows a pairing PIN, lists installed Steam games, and streams your screen to a paired AlaveX Streaming App client over your local network.
